title: Contact Support
description: Learn how to contact Matjrii support, get help with issues, and find resources for troubleshooting problems.
content:
Contact Support

Get help with Matjrii by contacting our support team, accessing documentation, and using available resources to resolve issues.

Support Channels

Contact support through:

  • Email support
  • Support ticket system
  • Live chat (if available)
  • Help center
  • Documentation

Before Contacting Support

Before reaching out, try:

  • Search documentation
  • Check troubleshooting guides
  • Review FAQ section
  • Search knowledge base
  • Check system status

Preparing Support Request

When contacting support, include:

  • Detailed description of issue
  • Steps to reproduce
  • Error messages (screenshots)
  • Account/store information
  • Browser and device details
  • What you've already tried

Support Ticket System

Creating a Ticket

  1. Log into your account
  2. Navigate to Support
  3. Click "Create Ticket"
  4. Select issue category
  5. Fill in details
  6. Attach screenshots if needed
  7. Submit ticket

Tracking Tickets

  • View ticket status
  • Add comments
  • Receive email updates
  • Close resolved tickets

Email Support

Send email to support:

  • Use support email address
  • Include account information
  • Describe issue clearly
  • Attach relevant files
  • Include error messages

Response Times

Support response times vary by:

  • Issue priority
  • Support plan
  • Business hours
  • Issue complexity

Self-Service Resources

Use these resources:

  • Documentation
  • Video tutorials
  • FAQ section
  • Community forum
  • Knowledge base
  • System status page

Common Issues

Quick links for common issues:

  • Common Issues
  • Payment Issues
  • Store Setup Issues
  • Product Import Issues
  • Theme Customization Issues

Emergency Support

For critical issues:

  • Mark ticket as urgent
  • Call support (if available)
  • Use emergency contact
  • Describe impact clearly

Feedback

Provide feedback:

  • Feature requests
  • Bug reports
  • Improvement suggestions
  • User experience feedback

Best Practices

  • Be clear and detailed
  • Include all relevant information
  • Be patient and respectful
  • Follow up if needed
  • Mark issues as resolved

Related Guides
